findings.class: QA case defect (not an implementation defect)
findings.problem: The soft-complex arm asserts `stagedTotal === 0` for the advisory route, but a live-model boot has TWO actors: the plugin (which must not provision) and the model (which the advisory notice explicitly invites to stage a team itself with agent_teams_create(approval="required", profile="mpd") when the work warrants one). The case therefore goes red whenever the model takes the invitation, which is not a clause-4 violation. Measured: my run red on side 0 (1 model-staged team, 9 agent_teams_create calls, advisory notice 1, provisioning notice 0); the L5 lane's three runs: red(0 teams but explicit side archived)/green/green — the outcome is model-dependent.
findings.requiredFix: Make the advisory arm assert the PLUGIN-side property and attribute the team record's origin: keep `provisionedNotice === 0` as the gating assertion, and treat an existing team record as a violation ONLY when the session log carries no agent_teams_create tool call (i.e. when it cannot be attributed to the model). Optionally record both branches (model staged / model declined) the way the explicit arm already counts active+archived.

findings.class: pre-existing product defect surfaced by the live engine case (inside a completed lane's file — plan §8 R1 candidate)
findings.problem: The mpd_ultrawork tool's declared output schema is `planFile: { type: "string" }` while the engine returns `planFile: string | null` (null whenever plan=false). The harness's output validator therefore rejects EVERY plan=false result: `Error: tool "mpd_ultrawork" returned invalid output: "value.planFile" must be a string` — measured live, reproducibly, on both calls of ultrawork-smoke (the model had to read `.mpd/ulw/<id>/state.json` from disk instead of consuming the tool result). plan=false is the DEFAULT for the /ulw command path, so the user-invocable surface this wave ships hands its caller an invalid result. The defect is PRE-EXISTING: `git show HEAD:packages/mpd-ulw-plugin/src/index.ts` carries the identical `schema:` line with `planFile: { type: "string" }` and the wave's diff does not touch it; no test covers it (engine.test.ts only asserts planFile truthy on the plan=true path), and ultrawork-smoke greens because it asserts on-disk state, not the tool result.
findings.requiredFix: Declare the field nullable (e.g. `planFile: { type: ["string", "null"] }`) or omit it when null, in packages/mpd-ulw-plugin/src/index.ts; add a unit test that validates a plan=false result object against the tool's own declared schema. Note the fix belongs to src (t8 rebuilds dist) and must not be applied by this verification lane.
